scripts.win: start cmd /c "cd frontend && npm run dev" && start cmd /c "cd api && python -m venv venv && @powershell ./venv/scripts/activate.ps1 && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn main:app --reload"
scripts.lin: gnome-terminal -- sh -c "cd frontend; npm run dev; exec $SHELL" && gnome-terminal -- sh -c "cd api; python3 -m venv venv; source venv/bin/activate; pip install -r requirements.txt; uvicorn main:app --reload; exec $SHELL"
